description: Send one question to several sessions at once, wait for their answers, and get them back together. `to` lists session names or refs, and "#channel" names to ask a channel's subscribers; at most 16 sessions. Each message names the answer tool and the ask id. The call returns when all have answered or after timeout_seconds, and says who did not answer. With pick "best" the smart-routing model, if your user turned it on, also says which reply answers best and how likely each is; that is its opinion, every reply is still shown, and the question and replies are sent to that model. A Claude session cannot ask Claude sessions this way: they are listed so you can use SendMessage.

pick.description: Set "best" to also get the smart-routing model's opinion on which reply answers best, with probabilities. It sends the question and the replies to that model.

question.description: The question, in plain text. Include everything the others need; they cannot see this conversation.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the answers, at most 280 seconds

to.description: Session names or refs from list_peers, and "#channel" names; at most 16 sessions in all

name: ask
title: Ask several sessions one question
